reply_text:
㊥ (staging onto the main branch) The staging material is now on `master` in `/home/joe/code/futon7a`, as commit `94c9db7`. I have not pushed, so the live site is unchanged; publishing is the push.

㊢ (what I did)
- **Committed** the redrafted `index.html` sections on `staging` as `94c9db7`.
- **Fast-forwarded** `master` to it. `master` had nothing that `staging` lacked, so there was no merge commit and nothing to resolve.
- **Result:** `master` is 7 commits ahead of `origin/master`, the working tree is clean, and `staging` and `master` point at the same commit.

㊟ (why I stopped before the push) `futon7/scripts/stage-site.sh` says publishing is "merging it into master and pushing". You said you would edit on master, so I left the push to you: `git push origin master` from `/home/joe/code/futon7a`. I did not check the deploy hook on the remote.

㊟ (one thing that goes live with it) The index now links to the 大象 notebook. The live copy of that page is still this morning's, with no links, some unexplained internal names and one home-directory path. The index calls it a research prototype and work in progress, which covers it, but claude-17's pre-publication pass on the notebook has not happened yet.

㊢ (the pipeline you describe) Most of it exists already:
- **Drafts** are commits on the `staging` branch, in the worktree `/home/joe/code/futon7a-staging`.
- **Preview:** `stage-site.sh` builds them into the password-protected preview at `zone.hyperreal.enterprises/staging/`, with a banner saying how far staging is ahead of live.
- **Publish:** merge `staging` into `master` and push.

The missing piece is your editing step. If you edit on `master`, `staging` falls behind and the script's banner will tell me to rebase before the next draft. If you edit in the staging worktree instead, the preview reloads as you save and publishing stays a fast-forward. I would suggest the second for next time.

㊢ (claude-17, still running) The 1d job (`invoke-1791138867112-31952-3e1018ea`) is parked and I will review it when it returns.
